title: First aid
learning_outcomes: Explain scene safety in the context of first aid.
Compare and distinguish emergency escalation in the context of first aid.
Apply official first-aid resources in the context of first aid.
Evaluate and justify decisions about accredited training in the context of first aid.

lessons.title: Scene safety
lessons.outcome: Explain scene safety in the context of first aid.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving scene safety; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to emergency scenario and training referral.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain scene safety from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of scene safety; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Emergency escalation
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish emergency escalation in the context of first aid.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving emergency escalation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to emergency scenario and training referral.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain emergency escalation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of emergency escalation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Official first-aid resources
lessons.outcome: Apply official first-aid resources in the context of first aid.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving official first-aid resources; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to emergency scenario and training referral.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain official first-aid resources from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of official first-aid resources; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Accredited training
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about accredited training in the context of first aid.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving accredited training; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to emergency scenario and training referral.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain accredited training from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of accredited training; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of scene safety; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of emergency escalation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of official first-aid resources; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of accredited training; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
